description: The European Geological Data Infrastructure is a free online platform developed by EuroGeoSurveys, the association of European geological surveys, to make harmonised geological information from across Europe easier to discover, view and reuse. It connects authoritative datasets, maps and web services of national geological surveys and partner projects through a Geological Map Viewer and a Data Search. Themes include lithology and geological units, mineral resources and critical raw materials (mineral occurrences, deposits and mines), groundwater aquifers, recharge and levels, geological and CO2 storage, and coastal hazards such as sea level rise, coastal flooding and erosion. Scales range from pan-European to national, with the interface in eleven languages. Data are reached through the viewer and OGC web services published by the contributing surveys; terms of use follow each data provider, and viewing is free without registration. Caveats: content and resolution differ between countries because the platform federates national data, and some layers come from completed projects that are no longer updated. For simulation it provides subsurface and mineral resource context for mining supply, geotechnical hazard exposure of infrastructure and groundwater studies. Related catalogue records include the EU Raw Materials Information System and the USGS Mineral Resources Data System.
